title.narrative: IA FUNDING TO IFRC CLIMATE RESILIENCE PLATFORM

description.narrative: Flexible funding to the Global Climate Resilience Fund, which gathers together all flexible funding to the IFRC Global Climate Resilience Platform enabling National Societies to deliver climate action specifically adaptation support in alignment with National Societies' needs, capacity and national climate action plans. The GCRP aims to support 500m people over 5 years since it's launch in 2022 to bolster resilience and adaptability in the 100 most climate-vulnerable countries. IT focusses on working across early warning & anticipatory action;safety nets & shock- responsive social protection;and Nature Based Solutions, complementing DRR efforts and resilience building efforts of the IFRC
